upcoming_events.title: Turn On The Town
upcoming_events.description: Seaside's holiday season opens Saturday Nov 28: the parade steps off from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM and winds to Central Square, followed by a live performance from Emerald Coast Theatre Company at Krier Plaza and the town tree lighting in the Amphitheater around 5 PM, with a visit from Santa. Free and open to all · 5-min walk or drive.

upcoming_events.title: Grayt Jackalope 10-Miler
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Nov 28, 2026 — 10-mile and 5-mile trail races start and finish at the Grayton Beach State Park trailhead, 10-miler out at 8 AM with the 5-miler ten minutes behind · packet pickup Fri Nov 27, 4–6 PM at Fleet Feet Inlet Beach · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Café Thirty-A Christmas Charity Ball
upcoming_events.description: Black-tie-optional benefit for Caring & Sharing of South Walton, 6–10 PM at the restaurant, with dinner and a live and silent auction · 5-min drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Holiday Market
upcoming_events.description: Saturday 9 AM–4 PM and Sunday 10 AM–4 PM in Central Square · local makers and gift vendors kick off the holiday season · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: New Year's Eve in Seaside
upcoming_events.description: Central Square's family celebration runs 4–9 PM with arts and crafts and a photo spot at the Post Office, live music from 5:30 PM, and fireworks at 9 PM · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Baytowne Wharf New Year's Eve Countdown
upcoming_events.description: The Village of Baytowne Wharf rings in 2027 with family-friendly live music from 6 PM, a fireworks show at 8 PM, a drone show over the lagoon, and a midnight fireworks finale · 35-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: 30A Songwriters Festival
upcoming_events.description: 18th annual · MLK weekend · songwriters across 30A's intimate listening rooms in Seaside, Rosemary, Alys, WaterColor, Grayton and more, with headliners including St. Paul & The Broken Bones and Gillian Welch & David Rawlings · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Sounds of Seaside Concert Series
upcoming_events.description: Through Dec 30 · Wed 4–6 PM · Free Wednesday-evening concerts on the Seaside Amphitheater lawn, 4–6 PM, running through the holidays with Roman Street on Dec 2 and Flow Tribe closing out the year Dec 30 · free and open to all ages · bring blankets and chairs, snacks and drinks welcome · 5-min walk or drive

Thu Dec 10 – Sat 12, three nights, both cottages open.

Golden Sun and Blue Moon side by side on the same lane — six bedrooms, four baths, sixteen people at one address.

The nearest beach access, Pelayo, is public county access, a 3-minute walk straight across Scenic 30A.

Book direct — link in bio.

copy.instagram:
Turn On The Town, Sat Nov 28 — Seaside's holiday season opens with the parade from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM and the tree lighting around 5.

Seaside is 1.8 miles up 30A, five minutes by car.

If you want the quiet week right after it, Golden Sun is open Tue Dec 1 – Thu 3: coffee on the covered patio, fireplace in the evening.

Book direct — link in bio.
copy.facebook: Turn On The Town kicks off Seaside's holiday season this Saturday, Nov 28 — parade from Seagrove Plaza at 3 PM, tree lighting around 5, all of it five minutes up 30A. Golden Sun is open the following week, Tue Dec 1 – Thu 3, if you'd rather have the quiet side of the season: https://book.sunandmoon30a.com
